components.content:
## DIN VDE Standards Overview

### Standard Categories

**Power Installations (DIN VDE 0100-0108)**
- General requirements and protective measures
- Installation in specific locations (hospitals, swimming pools, mines)
- Fire safety and lightning protection
- Voltage ranges from below 1 kV to above 1 kV

**Cables & Cords (DIN VDE 0245-0299)**
- PVC-insulated cables
- XLPE insulated cables
- Rubber cables and flexible cords
- Mineral insulated cables
- Halogen-free cables for improved fire performance
- Ratings from low voltage to 36 kV

**Testing & Measurement (DIN VDE 0472-0482)**
- Testing procedures for cables and flexible cords
- Insulation and sheathing material tests
- Smoke density measurements

**Telecommunications (DIN VDE 0800-0899)**
- Telecommunications cables and wiring
- Equipment wires and stranded cables
- Outdoor and indoor cable systems
- Optical fiber cables
- Electromagnetic compatibility requirements

### Key Voltage Classifications
- **Below 1 kV**: DIN VDE 0100 series
- **1-36 kV**: DIN VDE 0101, 0276 Part 620
- **Above 1 kV**: DIN VDE 0101, 0818
- **Low Voltage**: Telecommunications series (DIN VDE 0800-0899)

### Special Applications
- Hazardous and potentially explosive atmospheres (DIN VDE 0165-0171)
- Industrial machine equipment (DIN VDE 0113)
- Mining installations (DIN VDE 0118, 0168)
- Hospital and medical facilities (DIN VDE 0107)
- Lightning protection systems (DIN VDE 0185)
